warnings: NOBODY FORESAW IT, AND THE COURT SAID SO. On 16 July 2026 the Tribunale di Genova EXCLUDED the aggravating circumstance of article 61 no. 3 -- acting while foreseeing the event -- for every single defendant, and ACQUITTED all of them of the intentional offences under articles 432 and 437 'perche il fatto non sussiste'. The convictions are for negligence. No line, card, caption, title, thumbnail or description may say or imply that anyone knew.

THE JUDGMENT IS NOT FINAL AND ITS REASONS ARE NOT WRITTEN. 32 convicted at first instance, 25 acquitted or time-barred, an appeal announced, and Italy has three instances. Every named convicted person carries 'convicted at first instance' and 'not final' in the same breath; every named acquitted person carries the acquittal. Roberto Ferrazza was ACQUITTED.

THE COLLAPSE IS NEVER DEPICTED. No falling deck, no falling vehicle, no car at a broken edge, no debris field, no rescue, no casualty, no memorial with a face, in any frame including the thumbnail. The event is the gap afterwards, the scale of it, and a road that stops.

TWO AUTHORITATIVE FINDINGS DISAGREE ON THE CAUSE AND THE FILM RESOLVES NEITHER. The MIT commission (September 2018) held it more likely that the first cause was an edge beam or a box-girder deck rather than a stay, and called its own account 'plausible but not definitive working hypotheses'. The court's experts (December 2020) identified corrosion in the pier 9 south stay. Both are given with their date and author.

MORANDI DID NOT PREDICT THIS, AS FAR AS THE RECORD READ HERE GOES. Aspi commissioned a report from him in 1981 and maintenance followed. The contents of that report were NOT read. 'The designer warned about corrosion' is the sentence every retelling reaches for and it is barred.

HOLIDAY ITALY IS THE WRONG COUNTRY. Tuscany, cypress avenues, vineyards, Amalfi, Venice, gondolas, the Colosseum and Roman ruins are the same class of error as a US route shield in a Genoa film -- and the archive term `italy` returns exactly those. Genoa is a working Mediterranean port in a narrow valley. Italian signage in frame is present and UNREADABLE, never absent.

FACES ARE PERMITTED AND WANTED (owner decision 2026-08-21). The NEG blocks must NOT contain human face, facial features, eye contact or headshot. They contain identifiable person, recognisable person and likeness of a real individual. Ten plates stay in a carve-out with no face resolved at all, because their roles map to real identifiable individuals: the inspector, the officer who ran the procedure, the verifier, the designer and the committee.
